info.title: Shelf API
info.description: Catalogue, manual page progress, authenticated EPUB import/download, shared reader positions, and persisted bookmarks/annotations/reader preferences.

200.description: Object containing token, plus HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session cookie. Server sessions use a 30-day sliding idle window renewed on each authenticated request; the browser cookie Max-Age is longer so daily use never forces a fresh sign-in.

post.description: Mark finished: reading_status=finished; imported percentage=1; manual pages_read=total_pages. Optional finished_at (YYYY-MM-DD) stamps the new reading_events row (appends for re-reads; defaults to today). Correct a wrong day via PATCH/DELETE on /finishes/{event_id}.

finished_at.description: Client calendar day the book was finished (not in the future).

get.description: List finished events for a book (re-read history), newest first.

delete.description: Delete one finish day. Removing the last finish sets reading_status to unfinished.

post.description: Mark unfinished (not re-reading): reading_status=unfinished; clears completion progress; keeps imported position.
Mark re-reading: reading_status=rereading; clears completion progress; keeps imported position for later metrics.

404.description: Book not owned or not found

200.description: Object containing integer books, pages_read (manual entries only), finished, reading, and average_progress (0..1 mean completion across started books, including EPUB percentage)

post.description: Import raw unencrypted EPUB, PDF, or CBZ bytes without a fixed application upload-size limit. Exact-byte duplicates are account-scoped. For PDF/CBZ without a better title, optional X-Shelf-Filename supplies the catalogue title (filename stem). EPUB/CBZ archive path, entry-count, and extreme-compression checks apply. Available memory, SQLite blob capacity, and deployment proxies may limit very large requests.

parameters.name: X-Shelf-Filename
parameters.description: Original upload filename; used as PDF title fallback when metadata has no /Title

400.description: Invalid, encrypted, unsafe, unreadable, or unusually compressed archive

get.description: CBZ page count as `{ pageCount }` (Book Orbit comic reader).
EPUB chapter text blocks for TTS (0-based chapter index).
EPUB3 media-overlay playlist (SMIL timing) for resume and chapter lengths.

200.description: Playlist (empty items when the EPUB has no media overlays)

get.description: Enabled OpenAI-compatible TTS providers (no secrets). Empty means the reader hides synthesize-listen.
Curated voices for enabled TTS providers.

post.description: Proxy speech synthesis to a configured OpenAI-compatible provider.

get.description: List all TTS providers for settings (includes secrets).

put.description: Update a TTS provider (enable/disable, voices, URL, etc.).

get.description: CBZ page image bytes (0-based page index).

delete.description: Permanently delete a catalogue book and its stored file, position, bookmarks, annotations, and reader preferences.

200.description: Owned EPUB file: application/epub+zip. File downloads use attachment disposition.

404.description: Not owned, missing EPUB, or missing cover

200.description: Owned EPUB cover: image/jpeg or image/png. File downloads use attachment disposition.

404.description: Not owned, missing EPUB, or missing cover
EPUB not found or not owned

200.description: Owned bookmark array (camelCase Book Orbit fields)

404.description: Book not found or not owned
Book not found or not owned

200.description: Annotation array, or {items,page,pageSize,total} when page/readerFileId is set

404.description: Book not found or not owned

post.description: Create an annotation. EPUB rows use cfi; PDF reader highlights send pdf {page,rect,rects} (EmbedPDF page coordinates) which Shelf stores and returns for sync.

404.description: Book not found or not owned

200.description: Per-book settings object, or null when unset

404.description: Book not found or not owned

post.summary: Record a reading session (Foliate / file-id alias; id is book id)

404.description: Book not found or not owned

delete.summary: Delete a reading session by client session id

404.description: Book not found or not owned

post.summary: Import KOReader page-stat events as reading sessions
post.description: Clusters page-stat events (gap 1800s) into reading_sessions with source=koreader. Idempotent by derived kor: session ids. Optionally updates epub progress.

404.description: Book not found or not owned

post.summary: Import Kobo SpentReadingMinutes as a reading session
post.description: Derives a session from the counter delta vs reading_session_sync_cursors (source kobo-statistics). Idempotent by kst: session ids. Counter reset bumps generation.

404.description: Book not found or not owned

post.summary: Email an EPUB or PDF to the configured Kindle address
post.description: Uses per-user Kindle delivery settings (SMTP + recipient). Kindle domains get subject "convert". Max attachment 50 MiB. Set SHELF_KINDLE_SMTP_STUB=1 in tests to skip real SMTP. No request body required.

404.description: Book not found or not owned

get.description: SMTP password is never returned; hasPassword indicates whether one is stored.

put.description: Omit smtpPassword to keep the existing secret; empty string clears it.

get.description: Atom navigation catalog. Requires HTTP Basic auth against an OPDS user (not the Shelf session).
Paginated acquisition feed of downloadable books. Query: q, author, series, collectionId, page, size.

get.summary: List OPDS Basic-auth users for the signed-in Shelf account
Recent reading sessions for the current user
Daily reading rollup rows (raw; no chart shaping)
Session-derived reading charts (heatmap, source distribution, timeline)
Reading streak, annual goal, monthly challenge, and DNA widgets
Achievement catalogue with live unlock evaluation
Library health charts (format, language, storage, metadata)

put.summary: Update reading timezone and/or annual goal

password.description: Setup requires at least twelve UTF-8 bytes. Login accepts the existing password.

total_pages.description: Null for EPUB entries; use percentage instead.

reading_status.description: Catalogue lifecycle for stats; unfinished vs rereading are distinct reopen paths.

genres.description: Genre names from book metadata, sorted; omitted when none are recorded.

position.description: EPUB CFI or pdfpage(N); null before reading.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the uploaded file bytes (hex). Mobile offline cache keys on this.
